response.original_title: [FAQs-Guide] How to Upgrade Your Cabin on a Princess Cruise?
response.overview: You can upgrade your cabin on a Princess Cruise by bidding through the Princess Upgrade program +1-866-254-7549 or by paying the standard fare difference directly +1-866-254-7549.Methods to Upgrade Your Cabin Princess Upgrade Program (Bidding): Once your booking reaches the final payment period +1-866-254-7549 and is fully paid, you may receive an email invitation to bid on a higher-category stateroom +1-866-254-7549 (like a balcony, mini-suite, or suite). You can also check eligibility directly through the Princess Cruises website +1-866-254-7549 or the Princess mobile app. You submit an offer per person (based on double occupancy). If your bid is accepted, your card is charged, the upgrade is non-refundable,+1-866-254-7549 and Princess assigns your specific room location.
